parsed.name: ensemble_global_catalyst_book
parsed.strategy: Only names at least two independent lenses would pick: revision flow (net raises from many firms), dated catalysts inside Oct 12-Nov 13, power-grid inflection flags, and Asia supply-chain momentum. The book is semis/memory plus AI power hardware plus dated FDA and defense prints, so relative P&L comes from real Q3 numbers and PDUFA decisions rather than theme drift. I would be wrong if a single macro shock (hyperscaler capex digestion, Taiwan tension, or a broad CRL cluster) hits the correlated semis and biotech sleeves at once, or if the defense and gambling prints sell off on in-line results.
parsed.objective: Beat the Bloomberg WLS index on relative P&L from 2026-10-12 to 2026-11-13 with a long-only ensemble of dual-lens names.

strategy.brief: Ensemble: only names that at least TWO of the other lenses (power, catalysts, revision flow, policy, quality momentum, Asia supply chain) would pick. Say which two for each name. Competition rules: long only, global, <= 10% per name, >= 8 names, NO ETFs, cash <= 2%, graded as relative P&L vs the Bloomberg WLS index from 2026-10-12 to 2026-11-13.
